attack: A caller reaching api-catalog or api-save could obtain the first and last four characters of stored API keys; short keys could be disclosed completely.
rootCause: Response builders derived masks from secret characters.
impact: Credential fragment exposure; operational authenticity, authorization and historical attacker access remain UNKNOWN.
boundary: api/admin-parity.js catalog and create/update JSON responses
repair: Constant [stored] marker for present keys and empty marker for absent keys. Database keys and existing update behavior retained.
negativeCases: Short key does not appear in catalog
Generated full key and either four-character fragment do not appear in create/update/catalog
Client replacement input does not alter the stored generated key

evidence.layer: Controlled direct handlers with explicit in-memory Mongo; synthetic records and user

limits: No server authentication, tenant or role proof
Legacy plaintext storage and other admin response/error/export surfaces remain unfinished
